name: JW Marriott Phuket Resort & Spa
positioning: Beachfront resort directly on Mai Khao Beach on Phuket's quieter northwest coast, set in tropical gardens and wetlands, with an on-site sea turtle foundation
best_for: Families wanting three pools, a water slide and a kids club
Couples looking for a quiet beach with pool-access rooms or suites with private plunge pools

facts.text: The resort is located directly on Mai Khao Beach.
The resort is set within 11 hectares of tropical gardens, freshwater ponds and preserved coastal wetlands.
Mai Khao sits on Phuket's northwest coast, with 17 kilometers of natural beachfront and uninterrupted views of the Andaman Sea.
The resort is about 15 minutes from Phuket International Airport.
Mai Khao Beach is one of Phuket's last remaining turtle nesting grounds.
The main pool has a kids pool and a water slide.
Accommodations offer marble bathrooms and private balconies with views of tropical gardens or the Andaman Sea.
The spa has double spa suites for side-by-side treatments for two.
Kids Club by JW offers Day and Night Camp, plus a game zone with giant chess and movie nights.
A daily JW Garden tour introduces ingredients such as Anchan and Thai chili.
M Beach Club is a beachfront pool bar on Mai Khao Beach with smokehouse barbecue, cocktails and live music at sunset.
Guests can explore on complimentary bikes, sea kayaks and stand-up paddleboards.

highlights.text: The resort's Mai Khao Marine Turtle Foundation is dedicated to protecting endangered sea turtles and preserving their habitat.
The oceanfront JW Royal Villa has two king bedrooms, a private 18-meter pool and Andaman Sea views.
In the Grande Premium Pool Access Room, the private terrace opens directly onto the resort's lagoon-style pool.
Guest rooms feature premium Thai silk by Jim Thompson woven into bespoke furnishings.
The resort's three outdoor swimming pools sit next to the Andaman Sea.

considerations.text: Depending on the tide, the beach can be quite steep.
Most guest rooms face gardens and ponds rather than the sea.
The resort's pools and restaurants are shared with guests of the adjacent Marriott Vacation Club.
